criteria.definite_tail_loop: An exact repeated token or nonempty-line block continues to the 2048-token boundary, allowing only an incomplete final repeated unit.
criteria.probable_repetition_contribution: A long exact repeated block consumes substantial output immediately before the boundary, but the model resumes non-repeated text before truncation.
criteria.not_causal: The automatic detector finds repeated lines or blocks, but inspection shows finite case enumeration, ordinary tactic reuse, or repetition away from the truncated tail.

conclusion: Eight of 503 truncations are definitely caused by a continuing repetition loop. Counting two nearby long loops that materially consumed the token budget gives a broader upper estimate of ten. The remaining truncations are not classified as repetition-caused.
